app.title: QManager Installer
app.subtitle: Install QManager onto a Quectel modem — no internet download required
connect.title: Connect to your modem
connect.lede: Plug the modem in over USB, or reach it over your network. Nothing is downloaded — the installer carries QManager with it.
preflight.title: Checks
device.none.help: Connect the modem by USB. If it is connected and still not listed, ADB is not enabled in its USB composition — enable it on the device first, then reopen this installer.
device.unauthorized.help: Accept the debugging prompt on the device, then click Rescan.
check.root.blocked: Not running as root. The installer requires root — reconnect using a root account or session.
check.model.unknown: Unrecognised device — proceed at your own risk
check.model.identity_unreadable: Could not read the device's identity file, so its model could not be confirmed. Installing blind risks writing to the wrong device.
check.simpleadmin.found: SimpleAdmin is installed. Remove it with its own uninstaller before installing QManager. Found: {markers}
check.entware.unreachable: Cannot reach bin.entware.net and Entware is not yet installed. The install would fail partway through while fetching packages.
check.entware.have_opkg: Cannot reach bin.entware.net, but packages are already installed.
check.entware.none: No curl or wget on the device. The installer cannot run without one.
action.repair.detail: {version} is already installed. Reinstalling repairs a broken install.
action.downgrade.warn: The device has {installed}, which is newer than {version}.
action.uninstall.detail: QManager will be removed from this device.
action.uninstall.confirm: Remove QManager from {serial}? Settings are kept.
option.reboot.help: The reboot is what starts the services. Skip it only if you plan to reboot yourself.
option.skip_packages.help: Use this only if the modem has no internet access at all. It skips downloading Entware packages, which otherwise stalls for up to 30 minutes on a dead connection instead of failing fast. Only works if Entware was already set up on the device by an earlier install attempt.
run.wait: Keep the device connected. This usually takes about three minutes.
run.rebooting: Rebooting — this takes about a minute
run.done.detail: QManager is installed. Open http://{ip} in a browser once the modem finishes rebooting.
run.done.detail.unknown_ip: QManager is installed. Open the modem's web panel in a browser once it finishes rebooting.
run.cancelled.detail: The install was stopped partway through. The device may be left partially modified — run the installer again to finish the job cleanly.
run.log: A full log was saved to {path}
error.not_connected: Not connected to a device yet.
error.connect_failed: Could not connect to the device: {detail}
